From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP orientation: kickoff + evaluation plan (BrightOptics)

Hi Alex and Sara —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, we'd like to get a 60-minute MAP kickoff on the calendar to align stakeholders, confirm roles, and walk through the evaluation plan so we can lock a target close window.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed, Mar 9, 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Mar 10, 09:00–10:00

If neither works, share a couple alternatives and we'll adapt. For the kickoff, can you confirm the attendees and their primary responsibilities (decision-maker, technical reviewer, data owner)? That will help us route the right Redwood owners.

Prelim agenda (attached):
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- MAP timeline and milestones (10m)
- Evaluation plan: test sets & metrics (20m)
- Ops & integration checklist (10m)
- Next steps & owners (10m)

Attachments: MAP_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf, evaluation_template_v1.xlsx (please fill the template with sample endpoints and examples where possible). We'll also drop a calendar invite with Zoom once we confirm a time.

Redwood attendees: Grace O'Connor (owner), Marcus Lin (solutions engineer), Lauren Bishop (CS lead), Ben Carter (evaluation PM).

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference
